Research Training Program (RTP) International Fee Offset Scholarship
ᐱ
ON THE PAGE
About this scholarship
Each year the Commonwealth Department of Education and Training provides funding to Universities to award scholarships to International students undertaking Higher Degree Research programs under the Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP). The Australian National University offers the RTP Fee Offset Scholarship (concurrently with the RTP Stipend Scholarship) to support high achieving international HDR students who are conducting research which aligns with the strategic directions of the University.
Duration
Payments made for program duration
Eligibility
Scholarship type
Academic
Student type
International
Study level
Postgraduate research (HDR)
Selection bases
Academic merit
The Commonwealth Scholarship Guidelines (Research) 2017 set the basis for the conditions of award and outline the basic eligibility requirements for this scholarship.
Candidates are ranked and scholarships are awarded based on a competitive ranking process, to the top ranked candidates, subject to evidence they meet merit-based selection criteria, and subject to confirmation of a qualified supervisor, space and resources being available, in an area of research that is aligned with ANU research strategy.
Ongoing eligibility
Continuation based on academic performance
How to apply
No separate application is required for prospective candidates as all eligible will be considered based upon their application for admission, providing it is submitted by the scholarship deadline. When you complete your admission application for a HDR program you can select to be considered for Australia: ANU - Other Scholarship to be considered for all eligible scholarships.
This scholarship is assessed in two annual rounds. The application deadline to be considered in Round 1 (commencement of study in following year) is 31 August. The application deadline to be considered in Round 2 (commencement of study in same year) is 15 April.
Applications must be complete at the time of submission, including all supporting documentation and referee reports, in order to be considered in the scholarship ranking process.

Further information
The Australian Government Research Training Program International Fee Offset Scholarship includes:
tuition fees for program duration (4 years for PhD, 2 years for MPhil)
Overseas Student Health Cover for the student and their immediate family.
